data.name: NAWARO ENERGIE Betrieb
data.description: NAWARO ENERGIE Betrieb GmbH is an Austrian bioenergy producer headquartered in Zwettl, Lower Austria, operating biomass power plants and SynCraft wood-gasification plants that supply green electricity, heat and pellets to ~32,500 households. Biochar is a byproduct of wood gasification at its Perg plant (EBC and PEFC certified), sold to agriculture, landscaping and metallurgy customers; the core business is renewable energy, not CDR.
